name: O Loan boat race
nameVi: Lễ hội đua thuyền đầm Ô Loan
summary: The rite starts on the 6th of the first lunar month at the village đình and Lăng Ông. The races are on the morning of the 7th, on the lagoon 25 km north of the city, beside QL1 and the railway. The page names dragon boats, sõng chài, sõng lưới, sõng chống sào, lắc thúng chai, plus múa siêu, múa lân, and hò bá trạo. The solar date moves. Check on arrival. No fee was printed.
when: Rite on the 6th of the first lunar month. Races on the morning of the 7th. Solar date: check on arrival.
